heading: Wednesday, April 30, 2025
topLine: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-Prover-V2 for Lean 4 theorem proving.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-Prover-V2 for Lean 4 theorem proving
items.summary: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 is an open-weight model for formal theorem proving in Lean 4, released in 671B (built on DeepSeek-V3-Base) and 7B sizes. DeepSeek reports an 88.9% pass ratio on MiniF2F-test and 49 of 658 PutnamBench problems solved, and released a new ProverBench benchmark.
